summary: Provider preflight payloads are now explicitly scope-stamped, phase-scoped prepare preflight no longer persists to the canonical run-root PROVIDER_PREFLIGHT.json path, and certification only promotes live_provider_readiness=PASS when provider preflight is explicitly launch-complete and fresh for the current run manifest.
evidence_ledger: run_provider_preflight now stamps phase_scope, step_scope, scope_kind, and scope_complete_for_launch into provider preflight payloads.
prepare_phase_provider_preflight now writes PROVIDER_PREFLIGHT__<PHASE>.json and removes any canonical run-root PROVIDER_PREFLIGHT.json so phase-scoped probes cannot bless full-run readiness.
write_certification_result now evaluates provider preflight scope completeness and manifest freshness before promoting live_provider_readiness=PASS.
Targeted certification and operator-safety tests cover partial-scope rejection, missing metadata rejection, full-scope acceptance, stale manifest rejection, and D-only prepare-path behavior.
assumptions: RUN_MANIFEST.json generated_at represents the current invocation start boundary for launch-readiness freshness checks.
Canonical run-root PROVIDER_PREFLIGHT.json is reserved for launch-complete preflight only.
next_action: Re-run the bounded external launch-readiness review. Full-run provider readiness should now remain UNKNOWN unless the run-root preflight is explicitly launch-complete and fresh for the current manifest.
